plugin.note: Killerwatts have a 60% elemental weakness to air spells, so air Magic (Air Bolt/Air Wave, or a powered staff) is the fastest style despite their magic defence bonus of 20. Wear Insulated boots to roughly halve incoming damage; without them their Ranged max hit is 15.

requirements: 37 Slayer, combat level 50, and completion of Ernest the Chicken are required to be assigned Killerwatts.
The telescope in the upstairs study of Draynor Manor is used to enter the Killerwatt Plane.
Insulated boots are strongly recommended to reduce the Killerwatt's damage.
mechanics: Killerwatts have a 60% elemental weakness to air spells.
They attack with both Melee and a Ranged (magical ranged) attack at 2 ticks; their Ranged max hit is 8 with Insulated boots and 15 without.
Killerwatts are not undead, so the salve amulet does not apply.
They have Defence level 40 with a magic defence bonus of 20.

methods.label: Air spells
methods.summary: Cast air spells to exploit the 60% air weakness while wearing Insulated boots.
requiredOrKeyItems: Air spells (Air Bolt/Air Wave) or a powered staff
steps: Complete Ernest the Chicken and enter the Killerwatt Plane via the Draynor Manor telescope.
Equip Insulated boots to halve the Killerwatt's damage.
Cast air spells to exploit the 60% elemental weakness until the task is done.
notes: A powered staff (trident) is a cheap, high-damage alternative to bolt/wave spells.

methods.label: Ranged
methods.summary: Ranged is a viable alternative for players without strong Magic, still wearing Insulated boots.
requiredOrKeyItems: A bow or crossbow with suitable ammunition
steps: Enter the Killerwatt Plane with Insulated boots equipped.
Attack Killerwatts with Ranged; keep out of Melee where possible.
Eat as needed; without Insulated boots their Ranged hits can reach 15.
notes: Magic remains faster because of the 60% air weakness.
